From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC sprintboard pulse: trial roadmap & acceptance items

Claire — quick weekly pulse from Redwood as we enter week 2 of the POC trial. TL;DR: on track for the core acceptance gates but two infra items need coordination (IP allowlist window + SOC2 artifact share). See action items at bottom.

Status (high level)
- MAP version: v2 (attached MAP_Roadmap_v2.xlsx)
- POC environment: provisioned, baseline smoke tests passed (latency/basic throughput)
- Trial window: 2027-03-01 -> 2027-03-22 (per MAP)

Completed last week
- Model variant A deployed to dedicated test cluster
- Basic embedding tests and similarity baseline run
- Initial API integration with your test harness (tokenized calls)

This week (priority)
- Acceptance gating: finalize performance acceptance criteria and run 10qps baseline test
- Security/compliance: share SOC2 snapshot + confirm IP allowlist window
- Tokens: Redwood to provision test tokens and provide instructions

Acceptance criteria (as proposed)
- Functional: end-to-end generate + embed flows produce expected outputs per evaluation set (see MAP sheet)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms at sustained 10 qps for typical 512-token requests
- Throughput: sustain bursts to 20 qps for 2-minute windows without errors > 1%
- Quality: top-1 classification/score agreement within agreed thresholds on EvalSet-v1

Current blockers
- Finera IP allowlist: need the inbound IPs and preferred maintenance window to open firewall rules
- SOC2 evidence: Claire requested a redacted snapshot for procurement — we can share today but need to confirm scope

Action items (owners / due)
- Sergio: confirm proposed Friday sync (Mar 4 or Mar 5) and collect any changes to acceptance criteria (due Tue 2027-03-02 EOD)
- Marissa: package SOC2 redacted doc and upload to shared Drive (due Tue 2027-03-02)
- Vanessa: provision test tokens + send instructions (due Wed 2027-03-03)
- Finera: confirm IP allowlist window + contact for network ops (requested Tue 2027-03-02)

Ask: Claire — can you confirm the network ops contact and whether we should target Mar 3 02:00–04:00 PT for allowlist changes?

Attachment: MAP_Roadmap_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

—
Sergio Alvarez

Subject: Re: POC sprintboard pulse: trial roadmap & acceptance items

Thanks, Sergio — helpful summary. A few clarifications from the Finera side:

Acceptance criteria notes
- Latency: we'd like the 95th <= 300ms for 512-token gen at a steady 10 qps if possible; if that requires a model variant trade we can discuss.
- Quality: we'll use our EvalSet_vF1 (shared last week) as the single source of truth for pass/fail.

Security / infra requests
- SOC2: procurement needs a redacted SOC2 snapshot and a short statement on data retention. Please upload to the shared Drive folder and let me know when available.
- IP allowlist: we need the exact Redwood source IPs. Our network team prefers maintenance windows 02:00–05:00 PT. We can target Mar 3 02:00–04:00 if that works.
- Logs: we will need access to request-level logs for the trial window (read-only). Are you able to provide a limited logs portal or shared sample logs?

Network contact: CC'ing Finera IT so they can chime in with the ops contact.

I'll confirm our internal test harness schedule today and propose a time for the Friday sync.

—
Claire Zhou
Sr. Product Manager, Data & AI — Finera

Subject: Weekly pulse — sprintboard status & next steps (updated)

Claire / team — quick wrap from this week's MAP sprintboard updates. We ran the trial baseline and closed two of the top blockers; remaining items and owners below.

Updated status (color)
- Acceptance criteria finalization: GREEN — Finera confirmed EvalSet_vF1 and adjusted latency target to 300ms 95th.
- IP allowlist: GREEN — scheduled for Mar 3 02:00–03:30 PT and applied by Finera ops; initial connectivity validated.
- SOC2 artifact: GREEN — Marissa uploaded redacted snapshot to Drive and shared HS link (HS-Deal-45829).
- Token provisioning: GREEN — Vanessa provisioned ephemeral tokens; Finera confirmed token exchange via secure portal.

Milestone progress (trial roadmap)
- Smoke tests: PASSED (2027-03-02)
- Eval run (10 qps): RUNNING — earliest results show p95 ~ 290–320ms depending on request shape; we will finalize test matrix tomorrow and report pass/fail per EvalSet_vF1.
- Quality regression checks: ONGOING — first pass looks within threshold but we have a small mismatch on category X; Marissa to lead a targeted eval for that slice.

Open / next actions
- Marissa: deliver focused quality slice eval for category X and recommend tuning (due 2027-03-09).
- Evelyn: finalize logs export format and a one-page on how Finera will consume logs (due 2027-03-09).
- Sergio & Claire: alignment call to review final eval runs and sign acceptance (scheduled 2027-03-10T09:00:00-07:00).

Meeting invite: I've sent a 30-minute invite for Mar 10 09:00 PT to review final runs and close the MAP gates. Please accept or propose an alternative.

Thanks everyone — good progress this sprint. If anything slips, call out immediately and we'll escalate to the SLA ops channel.
